delivery.outcome: Publish the already merged and consistent Goal 2.1.290 artifacts to PyPI through goal -a publish-only and record independently verifiable publication evidence
nonGoals: No further version bump or version-carrier modification
No application-source, dependency-range or public-interface change
No remote branch push or Git release tag during the publish-only transaction

architecture.decision: Publish only the exact merged 2.1.290 state and allow Goal to refresh its generated README cost evidence and release notes without changing version state
architecture.rollback: PyPI releases are immutable; on publication failure retain 2.1.290 metadata, diagnose the failed transaction, and never overwrite an uploaded artifact

validation.evidence: PyPI accepts Goal 2.1.290 and a fresh isolated environment installs and reports that exact version
Version resolution remains already-bumped and fresh-base governance passes before the irreversible registry upload
